$description: Hand-written. Type, the same in every mode: font families, the text sizes, the heading scale (fluid between a minimum and a maximum), leading and weights. See design/foundations/typography.md. Sizes in rem at a 16px root.

xs.$description: The smallest text: captions and labels on graphics. Weight 500.

sm.$description: Small text: figure captions, form descriptions, table text, notes. Regular weight unless a style says otherwise.

org.openmined.was: openmined.org .text-small (14px): small text, captions, form descriptions

md.$description: Body text: the default size for reading text, form labels, values and options.

lg-min.$description: Lead at its smallest (narrow screens): it grows with the window to --font-size-lg at the 1300px page width, like the headings.

org.openmined.was: new in v2: 18px, the h5 minimum

lg.$description: Lead at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width: the introduction under a page title.

min.$description: h1 at its smallest (narrow screens). Page titles.

max.$description: h1 at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width.

min.$description: h2 at its smallest (narrow screens). Section headings; an article's top-level heading.

max.$description: h2 at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width.

min.$description: h3 at its smallest (narrow screens). Sub-sections.

max.$description: h3 at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width.

min.$description: h4 at its smallest (narrow screens). Minor headings.

max.$description: h4 at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width.

min.$description: h5 at its smallest. Page and interface text headings: Inter 400.

max.$description: h5 at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width.

min.$description: h6 at its smallest. Page and interface text headings: Inter 400.

max.$description: h6 at its largest, reached at the 1300px page width.

prose-h5-max.$description: h5 in a long read (.prose) at its largest: Inter 600, from the shared h5 minimum.

prose-h6-max.$description: h6 in a long read (.prose) at its largest: Inter 600, from the shared h6 minimum.

body.$description: Body text, interface text and labels.

h1.$description: h1. Every display level at 1.2, as openmined.org.

org.openmined.was: tight ramp (1.05) from the type round (2026-10-28) to 2026-10-29; openmined.org 1.2 before

h2.$description: h2. Every display level at 1.2, as openmined.org.

org.openmined.was: tight ramp (1.1) from the type round (2026-10-28) to 2026-10-29; openmined.org 1.2 before

h3.$description: h3. Every display level at 1.2, as openmined.org.

org.openmined.was: tight ramp (1.15) from the type round (2026-10-28) to 2026-10-29; openmined.org 1.2 before

h4.$description: h4. Every display level at 1.2, as openmined.org.

org.openmined.was: tight ramp (1.2) from the type round (2026-10-28) to 2026-10-29; openmined.org 1.2 before

h5.$description: h5 on pages and in interfaces.

text.$description: Body and interface text; h6; h5 and h6 in a long read; captions and tables.

prose.$description: Paragraphs and list items in long reads (.prose).

regular.$description: Body text and the display headings.

semibold.$description: Strong text, h5 and h6 in a long read, table headers.

display.$description: Letter spacing on the display face (h1–h4 and the pull quote), in em: write calc(var(--tracking-display) * 1em).

org.openmined.was: openmined.org (0); slight on display since the type round (2026-10-28)

numbers.$description: Letter spacing on tabular numbers (table cells marked .num, and .tabular), in em: tightens them while every digit keeps one width, so columns still align.
